sources.entry: 🧰 bradtraversy/design-resources-for-developers: design and UI resources from stock photos, web templates, CSS frameworks, UI libraries, tools...

summary.one_liner: A curated, link-only list of free and paid design resources for developers, covering stock photos, fonts, colors, icons, illustrations, UI kits, CSS tools and design software.
summary.what_it_does: This is a Markdown list of external websites grouped by category, each with a one-line description. Categories include UI graphics, fonts, colors, icons, logos, favicons, icon fonts, stock photos, stock videos, stock music and sound effects, vectors and clip art, and product mockups, with further sections for HTML/CSS templates, CSS frameworks and animations, JavaScript chart and UI libraries (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, React Native), design systems, online and downloadable design tools, Chrome and Firefox extensions, and AI graphic design tools. The README contains no code of its own. Its tables link out to sites such as Google Fonts, Unsplash, Pexels, Font Awesome, Lucide and Color Hunt. A banner states that new submissions are paused and the list is kept as a reference, so it is not accepting new resource additions. Some entries are free only in part, and the README notes that certain resources have licence limits such as no commercial use or required attribution.
use_cases: find free stock photos for a website
pick a color palette or check contrast
find free icon sets in SVG or icon font format
browse free fonts and font pairings
locate CSS gradient and pattern generators
notable: Very broad coverage, from stock media and fonts to icon libraries, color tools and mockup generators
Organized into clearly labelled sections with a table of contents and back-to-top links
Includes a range of browser-based tools, such as favicon generators and CSS gradient editors
Notes licence details for some entries, such as no-commercial-use or attribution requirements
caveats: New resource submissions are paused, so the list is no longer being expanded
Many linked sites are paid or freemium, and the README does not verify current availability or licences for each entry
Contains only links and short descriptions; it is not a software project to install
